newsitem.title: USA: Continental Air to buy warrants.
newsitem.headline: Continental Air to buy warrants.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said on Tuesday that it has agreed to buy from Air Partners L.P. warrants to purchase 3,842,542 shares of class B common stock of the airline for $94.2 million in cash.
The warrants sold by Air Partners consist of 2,314,687 class B warrants exercisable for $7.50 a share and 1,527,855 class B warrants for $15.00 a share.
The purchase price represents the intrinsic value of the warrants, Continental Airlines said.
Continental said the deal is expected to close next week.
